08 July, 2025
# BIS Hanoi students achieve exceptional IB results, continuing a strong tradition of academic excellence
3. BIS Hanoi students achieve exceptional IB results 2025
Our Class of 2025 at the British International School Hanoi is celebrating another year of outstanding success in the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme (IBDP) for the 2024/25 academic year.
##### IB Diploma
Armed with an IB Diploma, our students receive offers from their first-choice universities - half of which rank in the world’s top 100.
With an impressive average point score of 33.24, well above the global average of 30.58, BIS Hanoi continues to uphold its long-standing tradition of academic excellence.
This marks the eighth consecutive year that our students have outperformed global averages.
In addition, 9.7% of students achieved scores above 40 points, a remarkable accomplishment that highlights the school’s commitment to academic rigour and student success.
Our top scorer achieved an impressive 44 out of a possible 45 points on the exam.
Equally notable, 63% of the cohort earned the prestigious Bilingual Diploma (BD), demonstrating first-language proficiency in two languages.
...
#### Graduates heading to top global universities
Thanks to their strong academic performance and the personalised university guidance they receive, BIS Hanoi graduates have received over 150 offers from some of the world’s most prestigious universities.
Students from the Class of 2025 will be joining top institutions such as University College London (UCL), the University of Edinburgh, King’s College London in the United Kingdom, Boston University in the United States, the University of Sydney in Australia, the University of Hong Kong, and Waseda University in Japan.

content.text:
The latest results shown on BIS Hanoi’s website are:

- **IB Diploma, Class of 2026:** Average **35.11 points**, compared with the global average of **30.88**. **63%** earned a Bilingual Diploma, and two students achieved the maximum **45 points**.
- **IGCSE, 2025:** **46%** of grades were **A*/A**, compared with 23% in England; **85%** were **A–C**, compared with 55% in England. Six students earned all A*/A grades.

The school’s official results page also lists 2026 IGCSE results, but the figures weren’t included in the available information. Sources: [BIS Hanoi academic results](https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/bis-hanoi/academic-excellence/academic-results), [2025 IB results](https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/bis-hanoi/news/2025/7/8/bis-hanoi-students-achieve-exceptional-ib-results-2025), and [2025 IGCSE results](https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/bis-hanoi/news/2025/8/22/bis-hanoi-celebrates-outstanding-igcse-results-2025).
